name: Burpee With Push-Up
how_to:
1. Starting Position: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Squat Down: Lower into a squat and place your hands flat on the ground in front of you.
3. Kick Back: Jump your feet backward into a high plank position, keeping your body in a straight line.
4. Push-Up: Perform a controlled push-up, lowering your chest toward the ground and pressing back up.
5. Return: Jump your feet forward back into the squat position.
6. Explosive Jump: Drive upward into a vertical jump, reaching overhead.
7. Repeat for the desired number of reps or time.
